Pré-requisitos: Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. Diferencial: Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas. Você terá: Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa departnershipestruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente. title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Confira esta oportunidade para Data scientist - sênior (motor de busca) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários
Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais
Vivência com Big Query ou data lakes.
Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado
Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail:
Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App:
informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional.

Formação complementar em psicoterapia;
Fluência em outros idiomas;
Disponibilidade para educação continuada.

Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica;

Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas;

A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico:
Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica;

Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento.

Responsabilidade profissional;
Pontualidade e organização;
Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas;

title: Médico cardiologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico cardiologista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*
Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidadecardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADESFornecer atendimento médico especializado emcardiologiade forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbioscardiológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade emcardiologiae critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doençascardiológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde nsiderar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADESFormação Acadêmica:
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EMCARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.Certificações:
Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista emcardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento;
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).Experiência:
Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:
Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúdecardiolópetências Comportamentais:
Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes:
Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho:

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior data engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT
PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CVWe are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.Mandatory Skills Description:
• Readiness to work until 8.00 pm CET (no need to do overtimes)
• Overall years of experience required 8+
• Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).
• Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.
• Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, report and dashboard development, and building interactive, business-ready visualizations based on enterprise data sources.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, py Spark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.
• Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.
• Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.
• Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)
• Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.
• Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms
• Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage
• Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.
• Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.
• Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.
• Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT
PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV

description:

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.
We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.Why This Role Might Be for You
Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.
You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.

Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.

High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

description:

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink
Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.
Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.
Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão
Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.
Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel?
Como consultor Funcional, você atuará comoKey User funcionalespecializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência o será seu dia a dia?
Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.Para esta vaga, é essencial:
Experiência prática comprovada emSalesforce Sales CloudeService Cloud(mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
Conhecimento sólido deprocessos de vendas ,CRMeatendimento ao cliente(ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.
Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital.Você pode se destacar se:
Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant.
Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards).
Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware).
Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM.
Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce.
Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade.
Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops).

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.Role Overview
As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.Key Responsibilities
1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy
Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.
2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight
Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
Guide the use of Gen AI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.
3. Team Management & Leadership
Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.
4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization
Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.
5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control
Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.
6. User-Centric Content Improvement
Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.
7. Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.
8. Promotion & Growth Strategy
Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Key Traits for Success
Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience • Strong Python skills • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 • Real production experience with ML on AWS • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data • Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content • A strong eye for correctness and data quality • Business level English • The ability to work independently in a small remote team • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions • 12 month B2 B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.
Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system
(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).
Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.
Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location
Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Bi operations specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bi operations specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.
Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.
Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.Responsibilities
User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolveRequired Experience
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
Experience working with AWS
Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data toolsPreferred Experience
Experience working with Jira, Git Hub, and Confluence
Familiarity with the yard management industry
Awareness of logistics and supply chain managementAdditional Information
Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
Work with smart and creative people
Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).
• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.Job DescriptionThe Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in Git Hub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.
• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.
• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.
• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.
• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”
• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.
• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.
• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in Git Hub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.
• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.
• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.
• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.
• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Engenheiro de ia generativa - especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de ia generativa - especialista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Descrição da vaga
Buscamos uma pessoaEspecialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Suas atividades:• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.
• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.
• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.
• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.
• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.
• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.
• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.Perfil esperado:• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.
• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.
• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.
• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.
Requisitos e qualificações
• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.
• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como Lang Chain, Transformers ou equivalentes.
• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.
• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.
• Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.Diferenciais:

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior salesforce developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Required Skills & Experience5–7+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer
Salesforce development experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, Flows, Lightning Applications, SOQL, SOSL, Aura Framework
Experience with Salesforce custom objects, validation rules, workflows, reports, dashboards, and analytic snapshots

Ability to perform Salesforce admin functions as needed
Strong AWS development experience
AWS technical skills, including Node.js, Lambda, SNS, SQS, API Gateway, IAM roles and policies, Secrets Manager, S3, Dynamo DB, RDS, Route 53
Experience with REST APIs, command line tools, build and deployment processes, and application security
AWS architectural knowledge, including regions, availability zones, Cloud Watch, X-Ray, and Cloud Trail
Experience deploying with Cloud Formation, SAM build, and deploy
Ability to support large systems with multiple concurrent projects
Highly hands-on, fast learner, and comfortable owning enhancements and performance-related work immediatelyNice to Have Skills & ExperienceHealthcare industry experience
React.js, Amplify, Groovy
Event Bridge exposure
Experience supporting mobile application integrations
Background in highly customized, homegrown enterprise systemsJob DescriptionInsight Global is seeking a Senior Salesforce & AWS Developer to join a highly technical, hands-on development team supporting large-scale, custom-built applications. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and supporting Salesforce applications integrated with AWS-based data processing and distribution systems.
The environment consists primarily of homegrown applications, where Salesforce serves as the system of record and AWS is used to extract, transform, and distribute data to multiple downstream systems, state agencies, and mobile applications. This team is separate from Salesforce administration and is fully focused on development through code. The developer must be comfortable contributing on day one and working across all areas of the application ecosystem.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
